# odyssey-105 — new renderings (rows for the table in conventions.md)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἀγκυλομήτης (Κρόνου πάϊς ἀγκυλομήτεω, 21.415, genitive agreeing with Κρόνου) | "of crooked cunning" | "of crooked cunning" (+ note: first part ἀγκύλος 'curved, crooked', second part μῆτις; the exact sense is uncertain, 'of crooked counsel' is the traditional gloss) | "of crooked counsel" (μῆτις is "cunning", as in the ποικιλομήτης row), "wily" (reserved for πολύμητις "many-wiled"), "devious", "crafty" (each picks one reading) |
| καμπύλα τόξα (21.359, 21.362; one bow, plural form) | "the bent bow" | "the bent bow" | "the curved bows" (that is ἀγκύλα τόξα, 21.264), "crooked", "bowed"; τόξα is "bow" when one bow is meant, as in the table's τόξα row |
| πλαγκτός (vocative πλαγκτέ, 21.363, said by a suitor to the swineherd) | "straying one" | "you roamer" | "wanderer" (kept for ἀλαλήμενος / ἀλάομαι), "vagrant" (reserved for ἀλήτης), "vagabond", "wretch"; follows πλαγκτοσύνη "straying" / "roaming" |
| ἔλεγχος · ἐλέγχεα · ἐλέγχω (21.329, 21.333 ἐλέγχεα ταῦτα; 21.424 οὔ σ’ … ἐλέγχει) | "reproaches" · "puts to shame" | "a disgrace" · "brings shame on" | "blame", "insults", "scandal"; kept apart from ἐλέγχιστε "most shameful" (10.72), which is the superlative of the same root and keeps "shameful" |
| ὁμοκλέω (21.360, 21.367 ὁμόκλεον ἐν μεγάροισιν) | "shouted" | "shouted" | "rebuked", "jeered", "threatened" (each picks one sense); the noun ὁμοκλή stays "rebukes" |
| ὣς φάσαν · ὣς ἄρ’ ἔφαν μνηστῆρες (21.366; 21.404, plural counterparts of ὣς φάτο / ὣς ἔφαθ’) | "So they spoke" · "So then spoke the suitors" | "So they spoke" · "So the suitors spoke" | "Thus they said", "So they said" (keep "spoke", as in ὣς φάτο) |
| τανύω, of a bow (21.327 ἐτάνυσσε βιόν, 21.409 τάνυσεν, 21.426 τανύων) | "strung" · "stringing" | "strung" · "stringing" | "stretched" and "bent" (kept for τανύω of a lyre string, 21.407, and for τιταίνω), "drew"; ἐντανύω is also "string" |
| βιός (accusative βιόν, 21.328; 'bow', a poetic word, accent differs from βίος 'life') | "bow" | "bow" | "life" (that is βίος), "bowstring" |
| τέρας · σήματα (21.415 τέρας; 21.413 σήματα φαίνων) | "portent" · "signs" | "a portent" · "signs" | "omen", "wonder" (for τέρας); "marks" (the shipped sense of σήματα for the targets in the games, a different use of the noun) |
| κακῶν ἔμπαιος (21.400, ἔμπαιος 'skilled in', with genitive) | "versed in evils" | "versed in wickedness" | "expert in tricks", "skilled in villainy"; follows the table's "versed in" for εἰδώς with a genitive (πεπνυμένα μήδεα εἰδώς) |
| ἐϋκλεής (21.331, accusative plural ἐϋκλεῖας) | "well-famed" | "of good name" | "famous", "glorious"; follows κλέος ἐσθλόν "good fame" / "a good name" and ἐϋκλείη "good fame" |
| στειλειή (21.421, πρώτης στειλειῆς; the hole in an axe-head that takes the haft) | "haft-hole" | "haft-hole" | "socket", "handle-hole"; follows στειλειόν "haft" (24.235) |
| ἦ καὶ ἐπ’ ὀφρύσι νεῦσεν (21.431, whole-line signal formula) | "He spoke, and with his brows he nodded;" | "So he spoke, and nodded with his brows;" | "signalled with his eyebrows", "he gave a nod"; ἦ καί is "he spoke, and", as in the table’s ἦ ῥα καὶ … προσηύδα |
| κεκορυθμένος αἴθοπι χαλκῷ (21.434) | "armed with the fire-faced bronze" | "armed with bronze that has the look of fire" (+ note: κεκορυθμένος is from κόρυς 'helmet') | "gleaming bronze", "bright bronze" (reserved for ἤνοψ), "fire-bright" (reserved for αἴθων); αἴθοψ is built as in the table’s αἶθοψ οἶνος and αἴθοπα καπνόν |
